# netbox_module (Resource)

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/models/dcim/module/):

> A module is a field-replaceable hardware component installed within a device which houses its own child components. The most common example is a chassis-based router or switch.

Similar to devices, modules are instantiated from module types, and any components associated with the module type are automatically instantiated on the new model. Each module must be installed within a module bay on a device, and each module bay may have only one module installed in it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Note that some terraform code is not included in the example for brevity

resource "netbox_device" "test" {
  name           = "%[1]s"
  device_type_id = netbox_device_type.test.id
  role_id        = netbox_device_role.test.id
  site_id        = netbox_site.test.id
}

resource "netbox_device_module_bay" "test" {
  device_id = netbox_device.test.id
  name      = "SFP"
}

resource "netbox_manufacturer" "test" {
  name = "Dell"
}

resource "netbox_module_type" "test" {
  manufacturer_id = netbox_manufacturer.test.id
  model           = "Networking"
}

resource "netbox_module" "test" {
  device_id      = netbox_device.test.id
  module_bay_id  = netbox_device_module_bay.test.id
  module_type_id = netbox_module_type.test.id
  status         = "active"

  description = "SFP card"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device_id` (Number) The ID of the device associated with the module.
- `module_bay_id` (Number) The ID of the module bay associated with the module.
- `module_type_id` (Number) The ID of the module type associated with the module.
- `status` (String) One of [offline, active, planned, staged, failed, decommissioning].

### Optional

- `adopt_components` (Boolean) Adopt already existing components. Needs NetBox 4.6.0 or later.
- `asset_tag` (String) The asset tag of the module.
- `comments` (String) Free-form comments about the module.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the object, as a map of field name to value.
- `description` (String) A description of the module.
- `owner_id` (Number) The ID of the owner associated with the module. Needs NetBox 4.5.0 or later.
- `replicate_components` (Boolean) Automatically populate components associated with this module type (default: true). Needs NetBox 4.6.0 or later.
- `serial` (String) The serial number of the module.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) When the module was created.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `is_bay_compatible` (Boolean) The is bay compatible of the module.
- `last_updated` (String) When the module was last changed.
- `tags_all` (Set of String) All tags assigned to the object, including those not managed by Terraform.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The ID is the numeric NetBox ID of the object
terraform import netbox_module.example 1
```
